bill.title: An Act amending the act of March 10, 1949 (P.L.30, No.14), known as the Public School Code of 1949, in school safety and security, providing for prohibition of artificial intelligence for school-based mental health and counseling.

posted_text:
🧠 PA SB 1505 — PA Schools Ban AI Therapists – Here’s What Changes

Pennsylvania is stepping up to block artificial intelligence from being used for student mental health. Starting now, schools can’t use AI chatbots or other generative AI systems to diagnose, treat, or even recommend mental health care for students. That includes anything from chatbots offering therapy to systems suggesting a diagnosis or treatment plan. The law also stops schools from hiring AI companies to provide these services. ...
